question: The cultural festival ‘Thrissur Pooram’ is celebrated in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Thrissur Pooram is an **annual temple festival clasp in Thrissur, Kerala, India.**
 
• It is a clasp at the Vadakkunnathan (Shiva) Temple in Thrissur **annually**
